description: This file defines the ConverterReader class, which is responsible for retrieving currency exchange rates from a specified URL using cURL requests. It encapsulates URL setting and fetching functionality, maintaining an internal cache of the result.
external_files: PHP standard cURL functions (curl_init, curl_setopt, curl_exec, curl_close)

classes.name: ConverterReader
classes.description: A class that manages currency exchange rate retrieval via HTTP requests and caches the result.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL to retrieve currency rates from.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Supposed to return the URL, but currently does not return anything due to missing return statement.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Supposed to return the cached result, but currently does not return anything due to missing return statement.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a cURL request to fetch currency rates from the set URL and caches the response.
